name: siteswitcher
description: Cross-platform CLI tool for managing system hosts files with remote configurations

scripts.build:macos-arm64: bun embed-config && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 ./src/cli.ts --outfile=dist/siteswitcher-macos-arm64 && bun embed-config:restore
scripts.build:macos-x64: bun embed-config && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 ./src/cli.ts --outfile=dist/siteswitcher-macos-x64 && bun embed-config:restore
scripts.build:linux: bun embed-config && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 ./src/cli.ts --outfile=dist/siteswitcher-linux && bun embed-config:restore
scripts.build:windows: bun embed-config && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 ./src/cli.ts --outfile=dist/siteswitcher-windows.exe && bun embed-config:restore
scripts.build:all: bun build:macos-arm64 && bun build:macos-x64 && bun build:linux && bun build:windows && bun embed-config:restore
